name: api-client
description: A local-first, Git-native API development environment

scripts.check: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... && staticcheck ./...
scripts.cli:install: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly /usr/bin/reqly 2>/dev/null; hash -r 2>/dev/null; COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && go build -ldflags "-X github.com/Its-Satyajit/reqly/internal/version.Commit=$COMMIT" -o /tmp/reqly ./apps/cli && sudo install -Dm755 /tmp/reqly /usr/local/bin/reqly && /tmp/reqly version --verbose && echo "installed to /usr/local/bin/reqly (which reqly: $(which reqly 2>/dev/null || echo not-in-PATH))" && echo "cleaned old: ~/.local/bin/reqly, /usr/local/bin/reqly, /usr/bin/reqly"
scripts.cli:install:local: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly /usr/bin/reqly 2>/dev/null || true; hash -r 2>/dev/null; COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && go build -ldflags "-X github.com/Its-Satyajit/reqly/internal/version.Commit=$COMMIT" -o /tmp/reqly ./apps/cli && install -Dm755 /tmp/reqly "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" && /tmp/reqly version --verbose && echo "installed to $HOME/.local/bin/reqly" && hash -r 2>/dev/null; "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" version --verbose && echo "cleaned old: ~/.local/bin/reqly, /usr/local/bin/reqly"
scripts.cli:clean: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$HOME/bin/reqly" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly /usr/bin/reqly 2>/dev/null || true; hash -r 2>/dev/null; echo "cleaned old CLI binaries"; which -a reqly 2>/dev/null || echo "no reqly in PATH"
scripts.desktop:install: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop /usr/bin/reqly-desktop 2>/dev/null; hash -r 2>/dev/null; cd apps/desktop/backend && wails3 build && sudo install -Dm755 bin/reqly /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop && echo "installed to /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop" && echo "cleaned old: ~/.local/bin/reqly-desktop, /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop"
scripts.desktop:install:local: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop 2>/dev/null || true; hash -r 2>/dev/null; cd apps/desktop/backend && wails3 build && install -Dm755 bin/reqly "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" && echo "installed to $HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" && hash -r 2>/dev/null; "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" --help 2>&1 | head -n 5 || true; echo "cleaned old: ~/.local/bin/reqly-desktop"
scripts.desktop:clean: rm -f "$HOME/.local/bin/reqly-desktop" 2>/dev/null; rm -f "$HOME/bin/reqly-desktop" 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/reqly-desktop /usr/bin/reqly-desktop 2>/dev/null || true; hash -r 2>/dev/null; echo "cleaned old desktop binaries"; which -a reqly-desktop 2>/dev/null || echo "no reqly-desktop in PATH"
scripts.install:all: nub run cli:clean && nub run desktop:clean; nub run cli:install && nub run desktop:install
scripts.install:all:local: nub run cli:install:local && nub run desktop:install:local
scripts.clean:all: nub run cli:clean; nub run desktop:clean; echo "cleaned all old binaries"
